title: STS2 Tracker v1.3.7 - Resumed Runs Chronology & Real Completion Timestamp Sync
changelog: Fixed Run Chronology for Resumed Climbs: Multi-session or suspended runs resumed across days now sort strictly by their true completion timestamp rather than initial session start time
Accurate Run Numbering: Newly completed climbs immediately receive the top run number (#150) and populate at the very top of Climbs & History
Multi-Day Run Time Display: Cards accurately display relative completion time (e.g. 'Just now' / 'XXm ago') and modal inspect details both completion and start dates for multi-day climbs
Server & Cloud Completed Time Injection: Injected completed_time into API payloads and Firebase Leaderboard syncing
Web Save Import Enhancements: Drag-and-drop save uploads now preserve file modification timestamps as completed_time
notes: Fixes multi-day climb chronological sorting, accurately numbers resumed runs at the top of history, and displays true completion timestamps.
